description: The URL where the guest books this category on the website (alternative to create_reservation). / Der Link, unter dem der Gast selbst auf der Website bucht.

adults.description: Optional: number of persons aged 15 or older, used to pre-fill the booking form. Default 2.

category_key.description: Pitch category key exactly as returned by get_availability (e.g. BASIC, PREMIUM, PREMIUM_XL, PREMIUM_XXL, MINI or CHALET). Categories differ per event; do not invent keys.

children.description: Optional: number of children up to 14, used to pre-fill the booking form. Default 0.

event_slug.description: Event identifier (slug) exactly as returned in the event_slug field of list_events, e.g. formel-1-camping-spielberg. Do not guess or invent it.

nights.description: Optional: number of nights, used to pre-fill the booking form.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get booking link
